significance: A Theravada Buddhist temple at Sale in Myanmar's Magway Region that enshrines the Shinbin Maha Laba Man Buddha, a hollow gold-lacquered figure of about 20 feet said to be the largest lacquer Buddha image in the country. The image itself is dated to around 1300.
story: The image is said to have floated downriver from Monywa to Sale during the great floods of 1888.
